commentary.text: 90+9' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+2' 1 - 1 Goal! Matheus Franca (Crystal Palace) ran onto a clever lofted pass from Jefferson Lerma and easily beat the keeper with a header into the left side of the goal from close range. 1:1.

7' Some patient build-up play from Crystal Palace as they look to unlock the defence.
